usedFor: Google Business Profile collects reviews, and Gtwy receives each through “Call AI Agent Instantly” for an AI agent.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review Posted” in Google Business Profile, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: A new review reaches an AI agent in Gtwy as a chat request, ready for a drafted reply.

watchOut: “New Review Posted” is polling, so the AI agent chat starts after a scheduled check, not at posting.
